notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is a January 1950 newspaper report, quoted on Forest Lookouts; the Macon News original was not checked. Nothing found on completion, staffing, fire history, fate or present condition after two WebSearch queries and the cached pages. The state list entry (wenona, Crisp County, 451 ft, gfc-329) is assumed to be this tower on county and name grounds only; the story says it may be. The 1950 event is recorded as other, not built, because completion is not documented. The list gives the name in lower case. Access and status left unknown. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the list header says only 'elevation' with no unit; feet is read from the list's own values (Brasstown Lookout Tower at 4735 only fits feet), so the 137 m figure is a conversion. The story now paraphrases the Macon News wording instead of copying it, says the lookout site 'quotes' the report rather than 'kept a copy', and gives the full name-match reason for the list entry.
